{
  "task": "Manage lead capture and follow-up marketing campaigns",
  "benefits": [
    "Combines landing pages, contact management, email marketing, automation, and basic analytics in one platform",
    "Enables quick campaign launches for small teams without needing multiple separate tools",
    "Provides a simple-to-use landing page builder and easy contact/list features for lead capture and follow-up",
    "Offers helpful support for technical setup like providing DNS records"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Technical settings, especially DNS records for custom domains, are not easy to manage directly",
    "Adding various technical records often requires contacting support instead of being self-service",
    "Setup for analytics, email authentication, custom domains, and integrations can feel slower than expected",
    "Domain/DNS management is not clear or easy to control from one place"
  ]
}
